description: Seal-2 Route D structural prototype residual microblocks
hypothesis: Exact XML, template, citation, or schema microblocks have sparse deterministic residuals around decoder-available prototypes, allowing a bounded energy-ordered parity decoder to approach direct residual rank and beat causal coding after syndrome, framing, and fallback costs without attempting free-prose search.

mechanism.candidate_order: Hamming weight then lexicographic changed-bit positions
mechanism.structural_class: MediaWiki revision timestamp value and closing envelope

interfaces_exposed: deterministic prototype plus sparse residual plus canonical first-hit parity certificate
retired_neighborhoods: general MOIRAI WRT inference and unrestricted whole-page energy search

promotion_gate: Development-selected width must clear 2100 net bytes per raw million after parity framing and compressed source; bounded parity must approach direct rank and remain positive on page-disjoint holdout and a chronological offset.
kill_gate: Retire this timestamp class on nonpositive paid gain, less than 95 percent bounded reconstruction, material parity-to-rank excess, or nonpositive holdout or offset transfer.
decision: Retire the timestamp-envelope Q0 without a width, matrix, or expansion ladder. Every selected population lost to the matched causal control, development and holdout missed the bounded-search gate, and paid economics were decisively negative.
